info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Risk Assessment API
info.description: The Credit Risk Assessment API facilitates the evaluation of credit risk in wholesale trading operations. By accessing specific credit risk data using the provided parameter, users can gain insights into risk exposure and mitigation strategies. This API is primarily utilized by financial analysts, risk managers, and compliance officers to ensure informed decision-making regarding credit approvals and trading activities. It plays a crucial role in assessing the risk profiles of counterparties and optimizing trading strategies.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about a specific credit risk operation identified by its ID. It provides comprehensive information necessary for assessing credit risk management linked to wholesale trading.

requestBody.description: A JSON object containing the parameters required to retrieve credit risk operation details for the specified resource. This request body is essential for ensuring that the correct data is queried based on the provided specifications.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the credit risk data.

GetCreditRiskOperationByIdRequest.description: Request body for the GET operation related to wholesale trading and credit risk operations.

tradingBookId.description: Unique identifier for the trading book.

instrumentId.description: Unique identifier for the financial instrument.

side.description: Indicates whether the operation is a buy or sell.

quantity.description: Quantity of the financial instrument involved in the operation.

limitPrice.description: The limit price details for the operation.

recordStatus.description: Status of the record indicating its validity or verification.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update made to the operation record.

metadata.description: Metadata information related to the operation.

GetCreditRiskOperationByIdResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for the GET operation in the credit risk operations endpoint.

value.description: The monetary value of the limit price.

currency.description: Currency of the limit price, represented as an ISO currency code.

LimitPrice.description: Schema representing the limit price and currency for financial transactions.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate multiple messages related to the same operation.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: Geographical region where the operation was processed.

Metadata.description: Schema containing metadata information for the operation.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that processed the request. This value helps in tracing and debugging API calls.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that handled the request. This is useful for identifying which application instance processed the transaction.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes Bearer authentication, where the client provides a JSON Web Token (JWT) in the 'Authorization' header for secure access to resources.
